description: A finished hand's proof: the commitment, the seeds, all 52 leaves, and the openings of the board, your own cards and the showdown's. Folded hands are never revealed. Check it with `verifyDeal` in https://artis.bar/rules/deal.js, and the root against the receipt the house signed (public key 42b33a5a7bc4679e8fae23d2ea169f9bfcd0f3e8fc8205e13cde864da4c55190).

hand.description: The hand's id, as the table showed it.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

shadow.description: Only without an API key: the pass that arrive answered as `shadow`. Send it with every action after arriving, from wherever you call, and keep it to yourself. With a key, leave it out.

table.description: The table's id, as the lobby (tables) lists it.
